README: Three feature sets are compared head to head: thermal (in-situ camera only), sem (masked substrate morphology only) and thermal+sem. LOTO_* = leave-one-track-out: each fold trains on two laser-power settings and is tested on a third, unseen one (extrapolation across process conditions). WITHIN_TRACK_blocked_cv_* = 5-fold contiguous spatial cross-validation inside one track, which isolates how well the descriptors track LOCAL width variation at a known, already-seen power. FINAL_track_21 = trained on tracks 8/10/14, tested on the fully held-out track 21. baseline_trainmean_MAE_mm is the error of simply predicting the training mean width everywhere.

prediction_file.coordinate: x_mm = position along the scan direction in actual part coordinates, 20-100 mm window, 0.2 mm bin centres
prediction_file.cross_track_convention: left_mm / right_mm are cross-track (y) positions in height-map coordinates, 0 at the first profilometer row; width = right - left
prediction_file.split_meaning: LOTO_out_of_fold = predicted by a model that never saw that track; FINAL_held_out = track 21, predicted by the model trained on tracks 8/10/14

selection_protocol.rule: feature set = lowest mean CRPS over the leave-one-track-out folds; intervals = conformalised (CQR), calibrated on held-out tracks. Both decided without reference to track 21.

PRIMARY_unbiased_final_track21.note: conformalised (CQR), offset calibrated on the three leave-one-track-out folds

selection_protocol.caveat: The figures, predictions_track21.csv and feature_importance.* in this run use --headline=thermal, which was chosen AFTER seeing track-21 scores. Any track-21 number reported for a configuration other than 'thermal+sem' is therefore validation-informed, not an unbiased held-out estimate. With only three cross-validation folds the three LOTO rules above do not even agree with each other, which is itself the finding: at this sample size model selection is not reliable.

null_baseline.note: max |r| obtainable by chance when this many lags are searched over autocorrelation-matched surrogates; an observed best-lag |r| below this is not evidence of a real shift

thermal_lag_check.transfer_test_verdict: a lag chosen on the other tracks improves 2/4 held-out tracks; all skills remain negative
